A Narrow Confidence Interval for an Effect Size

Sequential accuracy in parameter estimation (AIPE). Each effect size has a function for the pilot sample size and a function that takes the data collected so far and reports the interval, the stopping criterion, and whether sampling can stop.

seq_aipe_R2()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Squared Multiple Correlation Coefficient
seq_aipe_R2_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Squared Multiple Correlation Coefficient
seq_aipe_c()
Sequential AIPE Check for a Contrast
seq_aipe_c_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Contrast
seq_aipe_cv()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Coefficient of Variation
seq_aipe_cv_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Coefficient of Variation
seq_aipe_gini()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Gini Index
seq_aipe_gini_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Gini Index
seq_aipe_r()
Sequential AIPE Check for a Correlation Coefficient
seq_aipe_r_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Correlation Coefficient
seq_aipe_reg_coef()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Simple Linear Regression Slope
seq_aipe_reg_coef_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Simple Linear Regression Slope
seq_aipe_sm()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Standardized Mean
seq_aipe_sm_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Standardized Mean
seq_aipe_smd()
Sequential AIPE Check for the Standardized Mean Difference

Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Standardized Mean Difference

Minimum Risk Point Estimation

Sequential procedures that stop when the estimated risk, the cost of estimation error plus the cost of sampling, is as small as it can be made: the coefficient of variation and the standardized mean difference. The minimum risk procedures for a mean are with the classical procedures.

seq_mr_cv()
Minimum Risk Point Estimation of the Coefficient of Variation
seq_mr_cv_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for Minimum Risk Point Estimation of the Coefficient of Variation
seq_mr_smd()
Minimum Risk Point Estimation of the Standardized Mean Difference
seq_mr_smd_pilot()
Pilot Sample Sizes for Minimum Risk Point Estimation of the Standardized Mean Difference

A Budget Across Groups

A sequential procedure for a linear contrast of several group means under a fixed budget, with unequal sampling costs and unequal variances, and the decisions it supports.

decide_seq_budget_noninferiority() decide_seq_budget_superiority() decide_seq_budget_inferiority() decide_seq_budget_equivalence()
Noninferiority and Equivalence Decisions for a Budget Constrained Contrast
seq_budget()
Sequential Check for a Budget Constrained K-Population Contrast
seq_budget_next()
Which Group to Sample Next Under a Budget Constraint
seq_budget_optimal()
Optimal Sample Sizes for a Budget Constrained Contrast
seq_budget_pilot()
Pilot Sample Size for the Budget Constrained Sequential Procedure

Studying a Design Before Collecting Data

Monte Carlo runs of a whole sequential procedure against a known data generating mechanism: the final sample size to expect and, for the interval procedures, the interval width and the coverage.

seq_aipe_R2_sensitivity()
Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis for Sequential AIPE: Squared Multiple Correlation Coefficient
seq_aipe_smd_sensitivity() seq_aipe_r_sensitivity() seq_aipe_cv_sensitivity() seq_aipe_reg_coef_sensitivity() seq_aipe_sm_sensitivity() seq_aipe_gini_sensitivity() seq_aipe_c_sensitivity()
Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis for Sequential AIPE Procedures
seq_budget_sensitivity()
Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis for the Budget Constrained Procedure
seq_mr_cv_sensitivity() seq_mr_smd_sensitivity()
Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis for Minimum Risk Point Estimation
format(<smsd_sensitivity>) print(<smsd_sensitivity>)
Print a Sensitivity Summary

Reading and Reporting a Result

The object every check function returns, with its print, summary, tidy, and glance methods; the path a procedure takes through the stages of the data in hand, with its plot; and a report of a procedure in words.

plot(<smsd_path>)
Plot the Stopping Path of a Sequential Procedure
seq_report() format(<smsd_report>) print(<smsd_report>)
Report a Sequential Procedure in Words
format(<smsd_check>) print(<smsd_check>) summary(<smsd_check>) as.data.frame(<smsd_check>) tidy(<smsd_check>) glance(<smsd_check>)
Methods for Sequential Check Objects
format(<smsd_path>) print(<smsd_path>) summary(<smsd_path>) as.data.frame(<smsd_path>)
Methods for Sequential Path Objects
seq_path()
Stopping Path of a Sequential Procedure for Data in Hand
